newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London quiet, HSBC drops.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London quiet, HSBC drops.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London showed few signs of life on Wednesday, with little activity aside from a fall in HSBC shares and some pressure on property counters, dealers said.
By 1505 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 37.09 points weaker at 13,082.04. Earlier the Hang Seng in Hong Kong tumbled 133.07 points to 13,119.13 as investors sold property shares.
Dealers said HSBC was trading around HK$1.00 below its Hong Kong close, after an early rally petered out.
"If HSBC close around this level, you could easily see them come back a lot further in Hong Kong time," one dealer said.

"The property developers were hit hard overnight but there hasn't been much follow-through in London, although a few of them are still coming under pressure," he said. "Hong Kong has been very disappointing this week, given the strength of Wall Street."
